---
title: "Carica Record su Google Sheets"
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <script src="https://apis.google.com/js/api.js"></script>
          <script src="https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client"></script>
    include-after-body:
      - text: |
          <script src="record-form.js"></script>
---

<div class="container">
<div class="row justify-content-center mt-5">
<div class="col-lg-8">

<div class="card shadow">
<div class="card-header bg-primary text-white">
<h3><i class="bi bi-file-earmark-spreadsheet"></i> Inserisci i tuoi dati:</h3>
</div>

<div class="card-body">
<p class="card-text text-muted mb-4">
Compila il modulo per aggiungere un record al foglio Google Sheets.
</p>

<form id="recordForm">
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="nome" class="form-label">Nome</label>
    <input type="text" class="form-control" id="nome" placeholder="Inserisci il tuo nome" required>
  </div>
  
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="email" class="form-label">Email</label>
    <input type="email" class="form-control" id="email" placeholder="nome@esempio.com" required>
  </div>
  
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="messaggio" class="form-label">Messaggio</label>
    <textarea class="form-control" id="messaggio" rows="4" placeholder="Scrivi qui il tuo messaggio" required></textarea>
  </div>
  
  <div class="d-grid">
    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary btn-lg">
      <i class="bi bi-send-fill"></i> Invia
    </button>
  </div>
</form>

<div id="message" class="mt-3"></div>
</div>
</div>

</div>
</div>

<div class="row justify-content-center mt-4">
<div class="col-lg-8">

<div class="card border-info">
<div class="card-body">
<h4><i class="bi bi-info-circle-fill text-info"></i> Come funziona</h4>

<div class="list-group list-group-flush">
<div class="list-group-item">
  <strong>1.</strong> Compila tutti i campi del modulo
</div>
<div class="list-group-item">
  <strong>2.</strong> Clicca sul pulsante "Invia"
</div>
<div class="list-group-item">
  <strong>3.</strong> Autorizza l'accesso a Google Sheets (solo la prima volta)
</div>
<div class="list-group-item">
  <strong>4.</strong> I dati verranno automaticamente salvati nel foglio Google
</div>
</div>

</div>
</div>

</div>
</div>
</div>
